name: aspect toggle beside a split phone mockup
looks: A short headline names two aspect ratios, the second in the accent colour, with a one-line caption. Beside it a phone mockup shows a split screen: an upload flow on the left half, a finished vertical video with a viewer reaction row on the right half.
build: ui-tilt-card for the phone (slight shallow tilt, soft offset shadow); the split inside the phone is a hard vertical clipPath divider with the two halves independently animated (DOM icons drifting in on the left, a small people-reacting row on the right).
sound: A soft whoosh as the phone settles.
prompt: State that the output fits two aspect ratios, the one meant for short-form in the accent colour. Show a single device mockup split down the middle: one half suggesting the simple input flow, the other half suggesting the finished vertical result being watched.
